body.name: Iess
body.type: finite invariant raw essential-incidence index set for a saturated order
body.def: \(\mathcal I_T=\{\operatorname{dir}(i,j):i,j\in W,\ i\ne j\}\cup\{\operatorname{src}(C,j):\varnothing\ne C\subseteq W,\ j\in C\}\), with \(|\mathcal I_T|\le N(N-1)+N2^{N-1}\).  The labels \(C\) identify formal saturated source slots; the realized child set of a slot is the set of its positive incidence signs, after which empty sets are discarded and equal nonempty realized child sets are merged canonically.  The raw index and the normalized realized index are invariant to source-value, source-order, and response-label permutations.
